input.command: scripts/quest-runner issues create --scope physicalplan --title "Local-inference config key path in Slice 1/4 plans contradicts committed config files" --description $'Slice 1 plan (line 34) says to add a nested "sheaf_chat" section in global_config.json holding local_inference_url, and Slice 4 plan (line 11) says the local provider reads sheaf_chat.local_inference_url from global_config.json. The already-committed config/global_config.json stores it top-level as local_inference_url ("http://studio.local:8000/v1/") with no sheaf_chat wrapper. The spec is itself inconsistent: the Service Registration section shows top-level {"local_inference_url": ".../v1"} and api_keys local_inference_api_key, while the Providers And Models section references sheaf_chat.local_inference_url and sheaf_chat.local_api_key. As written, an implementer following Slice 1/4 literally would restructure the committed config into a nested block, contradicting both the committed file and the spec registration example, causing churn. Slice 4 already uses the committed top-level key name local_inference_api_key for api_keys.json but the nested form only for the URL, so the two plans are also inconsistent with each other. Resolution: pick one canonical config shape (recommend matching the committed files: top-level local_inference_url in global_config.json and local_inference_api_key in api_keys.json) and make Slice 1 and Slice 4 plan text agree with it and with the committed config. To close: Slice 1 and Slice 4 plans reference the same config key path, and that path matches the already-committed config/global_config.json and config/api_keys.example.json.'
